entries.question: Where can I get a list of biogas and biomethane plants in operation in Spain, with location, production capacity, feedstock, operator and whether they inject into the gas grid?

entries.question: Where can I get a list of biogas and biomethane projects currently in permitting in Spain, with location, capacity, developer, permitting stage and date?

entries.question: Where can I get cadastral parcel boundaries (geometry) for all of Spain, with parcel identifier and area, as a bulk download or as a queryable service?

entries.question: Where can I get a list of thermal and nuclear power plants in Spain, with location, fuel or technology, capacity (MW), operator, status and annual generation?

entries.question: Where can I get the locations or boundaries of protected cultural heritage and archaeological sites in Spain, with protection category and the authority that holds the register?

entries.question: Where can I get renewable curtailment and redispatch volumes in Spain, by zone or node and by period?

entries.question: Where can I get a list of data centers in operation in Spain, with location, operator and capacity (IT power in MW or floor area)?

entries.question: Where can I get a list of data center projects currently in permitting in Spain, with location, power (MW), developer, permitting stage and date?

entries.question: Where can I get annual agricultural crop production statistics in Spain, by crop and territory, with production volume, crop area, yield and historical series?

entries.question: Where can I get the list of grid connection requests in the United States, with project, technology, capacity (MW), connection node, status and date?
entries.summary: Queue lists are published per ISO/RTO: MISO JSON, CAISO and NYISO Excel were tested; PJM viewer, other RTOs and the LBNL compilation remain open.

entries.question: Where can I get a list of solar PV projects currently in permitting in the United States, with location, capacity (MW), developer, permitting stage and date?
entries.summary: No national permitting list: NY ORES and CEC Opt-In registers and BLM ePlanning were examined; EIA-860M offers a national lead with approval-status codes.

entries.question: Where can I get flood hazard zones (geometry) in the United States, with return period or probability and the issuing authority?
entries.summary: FEMA's NFHL gives national zone geometry: 1% (A, AE, V), shaded X with several meanings, D undetermined. FEMA hosts failed here; geometry tested in a 2022 copy.

entries.question: Where can I get a list of solar PV plants in operation in the United States, with location, capacity (MW), operator and commissioning date?
entries.summary: EIA-860 2025 lists 7,979 operating PV generators at 7,309 plants (1 MW plant scope); USPVDB v4.0 maps 6,611 ground-mounted facilities; no per-plant list under 1 MW.

entries.question: Where can I get a list of battery storage (BESS) installations in operation in the United States, with location, power (MW), energy (MWh), operator and commissioning date?
entries.summary: EIA-860M/860 list operating batteries with plant coordinates, MW, MWh, operator and month/year, for plants of 1 MW or more.

entries.question: Where can I get a list of data center projects currently in permitting in the United States, with location, power (MW), developer, permitting stage and date?
entries.summary: No national list: Loudoun and Prince William (VA) publish stage layers without MW or applicant; DOE federal sites give named selections.

entries.question: Where can I get the available grid connection capacity per substation or node in the United States, for generation and for demand, with the latest value and its history?
entries.summary: No national dataset: PG&E, SCE and National Grid NY publish ArcGIS hosting-capacity layers; CAISO gives a transmission heatmap viewer only.

entries.question: Where can I get a list of large industrial facilities in the United States, with location, sector, operator and annual emissions by pollutant, including CO2?
entries.summary: EPA GHGRP (CO2, RY2023), TRI (toxics, RY2024) and NEI 2023 (air pollutants) give facility emissions; ids differ across programs.

entries.question: Where can I get a list of wind farms in operation in the United States, with location, capacity (MW), number of turbines, operator and commissioning date?
entries.summary: USGS USWTDB gives turbine coordinates, MW and year; EIA-860 adds operator and turbine counts per plant; join on EIA plant code.

entries.question: Where can I get a list of thermal and nuclear power plants in the United States, with location, fuel or technology, capacity (MW), operator, status and annual generation?
entries.summary: EIA-860 (generators, plants, status, operator), 860M (monthly) and 923 (2025 net MWh) are structured downloads joinable on plant code; 11,194 fossil and nuclear generators at 3,128 plants.

entries.question: Where can I get renewable curtailment and redispatch volumes in the United States, by zone or node and by period?
entries.summary: Only CAISO publishes full series (daily MWh by type, monthly CSV from 2014, exceptional dispatch MWh); MISO gives daily MW in PDF charts, ERCOT annual percentages; no zone or node values found.

entries.question: Where can I get a list of hydropower plants and dams in the United States, with location, capacity (MW), reservoir volume, operator and annual generation?
entries.summary: No official key links EIA hydro plants to dams: EIA-860/923 give MW, operator and 2025 MWh; USACE's NID gives dam location and storage. 967 of 1,457 plants match an NID dam within 1 km.

entries.question: Where can I get the routes (geometry) of electricity transmission and distribution lines in the United States, with voltage level, operator and status?
entries.summary: No live federal layer: HIFLD Open was withdrawn in 2025; an Esri archive (to 2024-09-30) has 94,619 transmission segments. CEC (California) and utilities such as National Grid NY publish their own layers.

entries.question: How can I find out who owns a given land parcel in the United States: which register holds ownership, whether it is open, and the legal route and cost to obtain it?
entries.summary: No national owner register: look up the county assessor roll, then the recorder's deeds; Denver and Travis searches are open, fees are for copies.

entries.question: Where can I get the current land-use and zoning plans of the United States as geometry, with land classification and the planning instrument they belong to?
entries.summary: No official national zoning geometry found; Denver and Austin publish open polygon APIs with district codes and ordinance links; national layers are paid or viewer-only.

entries.question: Where can I get the official zoning that classifies land for renewable energy siting in the United States, such as environmental sensitivity maps or renewables acceleration areas, as geometry, with category and the technologies it applies to?
entries.summary: BLM publishes solar zone, DRECP focus-area and Solar PEIS exclusion layers for western public lands; California CEC publishes exclusion footprints; no national siting zoning found.

entries.question: Where can I get rural land prices or rural land transactions in the United States, by municipality or region and year?
entries.summary: USDA NASS gives state-level farm, crop and pasture land value per acre (1850-2026) and county values for 1997-2022; sales are state-level (Vermont tested).

entries.question: Where can I get a list of desalination plants in the United States, with location, capacity, technology, operator and status?
entries.summary: No current national list. Reclamation Report 207 (2018, municipal only), TWDB Texas database (60 plants, 2024), California 2019 maps and operator pages; capacity, status and location vary.

entries.question: Where can I get a list of drinking water treatment plants in the United States, with location, capacity and operator?
entries.summary: No national plant list. SDWIS/ECHO give systems and monitoring points without coordinates or capacity; Iowa DNR gives plant points; operators such as MWD publish capacity in documents.

entries.question: Where can I get a list of urban wastewater treatment plants in the United States, with location, design capacity, treated volume and treatment level?
entries.summary: National: EPA CWNS 2022 (CSV, ~16,450 treatment plants) and ECHO API (16,996 POTW permit rows, DMR flows); Florida DEP register. Design flow, permit and measured flow differ.

entries.question: Where can I get the register of water abstraction rights and concessions in the United States, with location, holder, use, authorised volume and status?
entries.summary: No national register. Tested state registers: California CalWATRS (CSV/API), Colorado CDSS REST API, Oregon OWRD layers and WRIS. Location, use, amounts, status and holder fields vary by state.

entries.question: Where can I get the locations of known mineral deposits and occurrences in the United States, with commodity, size or grade, and status (explored, mined, abandoned)?
entries.summary: USGS MRDS (266,599 US records, frozen 2011) gives location, commodity and status; size and grade are partial. USMIN, ARDF and state surveys add regional or critical-mineral detail.

entries.question: Where can I get a list of active mines and quarries in the United States, with location, mineral or rock extracted, operator and annual production?
entries.summary: MSHA lists 6,671 Active US mines with location, operator and primary commodity; per-mine production exists for coal (MSHA) and Pennsylvania noncoal only.

entries.question: Where can I get mining rights in the United States (exploration permits and mining concessions) as geometry, with holder, commodity, status and dates?
entries.summary: BLM MLRS publishes 598,739 non-closed mining claims as PLSS-derived polygons with status; commodity, holder and dates appear only in other BLM layers. Alaska DNR adds 123,061 state claims.

entries.question: Where can I get the routes (geometry) of oil product pipelines and a list of refineries in the United States, with location, operator, capacity and status?
entries.summary: EIA lists 130 operable US refineries with capacity and status by city; pipeline routes are not public downloads (PHMSA NPMS restricted), with only crude and HGL line copies found.

entries.question: Where can I get a list of biogas and biomethane projects currently in permitting in the United States, with location, capacity, developer, permitting stage and date?
entries.summary: No national in-permitting list: CEQAnet shows dated California approvals (Manteca, Turlock); EPA LMOP (102 landfill RNG) and AgSTAR (73 digesters) give status only; capacity is unpublished.

entries.question: Where can I get a list of biogas and biomethane plants in operation in the United States, with location, production capacity, feedstock, operator and whether they inject into the gas grid?
entries.summary: EPA LMOP (110 landfill RNG projects) and AgSTAR (400 livestock digesters) give plant-level lists; no national file covers all biogas/RNG plants with capacity, feedstock and injection.

entries.question: Where can I get a list of hydrogen production projects currently in permitting in the United States, with location, capacity (MW), developer, permitting stage and date?
entries.summary: No national in-permitting list: DOE Record 24001 has 43 planned rows without stage; dockets show Lancaster CA (400 MWe, approved 2024-03) and Graham TX (120 MW, FONSI 2025-01, sale agreed 2026-07).

entries.question: Where can I get a list of hydrogen production plants (electrolysers) in operation in the United States, with location, capacity (MW), operator and commissioning date?
entries.summary: DOE Record 24001 (May 2024) lists 70 installed US electrolyzer rows (about 116 MW) with city, kW and status; operators and dates exist only in company releases (two checked).

entries.question: Where can I get a list of airports in the United States, with location, operator and annual passengers, cargo and aircraft movements?
entries.summary: FAA NASR airport list with owner and manager names; FAA CY2025 enplanements and cargo; BTS T-100 2024 passengers, departures and freight; FAA TAF operations to FY2024. Join by airport identifier.

entries.question: Where can I get a list of commercial ports in the United States, with location, port authority and annual cargo, passengers and vessel calls?
entries.summary: USACE Principal Ports (150, CY2023 short tons), port areas and docks with owners; BTS Port Data with TEU, tonnage and vessel calls by USACE port code; cruise passengers for the top 25 ports.

entries.question: Where can I get the railway network (geometry) of the United States, with line type, electrification, infrastructure manager and traffic?
entries.summary: NARN (FRA/BTS) rail lines with owner marks, trackage rights, passenger type and active or abandoned class; no electrification or traffic field; train counts only at FRA crossings; OSM tags electrification.

entries.question: Where can I get the road network (geometry) of the United States, with road category, owner and traffic volume (annual average daily traffic)?
entries.summary: HPMS section lines with functional class, owner code and AADT for US public roads (BTS state services, FHWA national table); AADT mainly on Federal-aid roads; state GIS add count stations.
